findings.finding: A_R5_01_IID_INNOVATION_BASE is proof-critical for residue-class independence, but the frozen G-A2 actual-process model-use schema and model-use template do not explicitly require an acceptance verdict for that structural representation.
findings.consequence: G-A2 could be interpreted as passing after numeric model-use inputs are accepted without an explicit affirmative acceptance of the innovation representation required by P2/P7.
findings.required_resolution: Make actual-process model-use acceptance explicitly include A_R5_01_IID_INNOVATION_BASE for the identical declared process scope.

findings.finding: The final finite-memory blocking/Hoeffding band is a project-specific lemma chain rather than a verbatim theorem from one publication.
